title: light and dark mode in dev console
features: you can switch between light mode and dark mode console now!!!!!!!!!11111!!!!!!1111
script:
-- configuration
local mode = 1 -- 0 for dark mode, 1 for light mode
-- code
if mode == 1 then
	game:FindService("CoreGui").DevConsoleMaster.DevConsoleWindow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
elseif mode == 0 then
	game:FindService("CoreGui").DevConsoleMaster.DevConsoleWindow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
end
